build_attention_pooler: build an AttentionPooler that pools input embeddings to n_queries using cross-attention with learned query embeddings
create_cascaded_attention_pooler: create a CascadedAttentionPooler that chains multiple AttentionPoolers to produce pooled outputs from each stage
run_attention_pooler_forward: run the forward pass of AttentionPooler on a tensor of shape batch_size seq_len input_embed_dim
test_cascaded_pooler_forward: test the CascadedAttentionPooler forward pass to verify it returns a list of pooled tensors from each pooler
review_attention_pooler_init: review the AttentionPooler constructor to understand how query parameters and layer norms are initialized
